scope: Candidate read-only named-partition metadata source; installed availability/access not observed
findings: Source registers proc partinfo with mode0444 and read-only file operations.
Iterator selects mmcblk0 and reports partition volume names, start_sect*512 and nr_sects*512 in hexadecimal byte units.
pgpt and sgpt entries are synthetic512KiB rows; sgpt start derives from the last iterated partition, not independently parsed backup GPT location.
Build inclusion is conditional; mode0444 does not establish installed presence or SELinux/shell access.
